name: mond-compat
subtitle: MobileGestalt editor with iOS 27.0.1 diagnostics
description: Unsigned compatibility build based on rooootdev/mond. Signing must preserve a registered App Group in the provisioning profile. Compatibility claims are not proof of exploit success.

apps.name: mond-compat
apps.subtitle: worse_query App Group diagnostics
apps.localizedDescription: MobileGestalt, PosterBoard and HouseArrest tooling with clearer worse_query errors and a configurable signing App Group. An authorized App Group is required; do not apply tweaks when access checks fail.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial compatibility build for iOS 27.0.1 diagnostics and App Group signing checks.
versions.changelog: Recognize iOS 27.0.1; correct worse_query error-code mapping; show App Group accessibility and configurable identifier; use independent bundle ID and record installed version/build.
